```{r}

library(polycor)

```

```{r}
caff_data <- read_csv("data/raw/caffeine_sensitivity_clean copy.csv") %>%
  filter(if_all(caff_intox_revised_1:caff_intox_revised_12, ~ !is.na(.))) %>%
  select(caff_intox_1:caff_intox_12, caff_intox_revised_1:caff_intox_revised_12) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(caff_intox_1:caff_intox_12,
        caff_intox_revised_1:caff_intox_revised_12),
      ~ factor(.)
    ))
```

```{r}
# Distribution plots - Revised items
efa_items <- caff_data[, paste0("caff_intox_revised_", 1:12)]

# Long format
items_long <- efa_items %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "item",
    values_to = "response"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    item = factor(
      item,
      levels = paste0("caff_intox_revised_", 1:12)
    )
  )
  
ggplot(items_long, aes(x = factor(response))) +
  geom_bar() +
  facet_wrap(~ item, ncol = 3, scales = "fixed") +
  scale_x_discrete(
    limits = c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Value",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#KMO
R <- cor(

)

KMO(R)
```

```{r}
#Bartlett
cortest.bartlett(
  R,
  n = nrow(caff_data)
)
```

```{r}
# EFA
poly_cor <- hetcor(caff_data)$correlations

efa <- fa(
  poly_cor,
  nfactors = 2,
  fm = "pa",
  rotate = "oblimin",
  n.obs = 501
)

print(efa, cut = 0.30, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#Eigen value

eigenvalues <- eigen(poly_cor)$values

eigenvalues # 5.1533569 1.1587473 1.0238737... 
```

```{r}
#Parallel analysis

set.seed(1234)

n <- nrow(efa_data)
p <- ncol(efa_data)
n_iter <- 100

random_eigenvalues <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_iter,
  ncol = p
)

for (i in 1:n_iter) {
  
  random_data <- matrix(
    sample(
      1:5,
      size = n * p,
      replace = TRUE
    ),
    nrow = n,
    ncol = p
  )
  
  random_cor <- hetcor(random_data)$correlations
  
  random_eigenvalues[i, ] <- eigen(random_cor)$values
}

mean_random_eigenvalues <- colMeans(random_eigenvalues)

parallel_table <- data.frame(
  Faktor = 1:p,
  Real_Eigenvalue = eigenvalues,
  Random_Eigenvalue = mean_random_eigenvalues
)

parallel_table #1 faktort javasol 
```

```{r}
#Scree plot

plot(
  1:p,
  eigenvalues,
  type = "b",
  pch = 19,
  ylim = range(
    c(eigenvalues, mean_random_eigenvalues)
  ),
  xlab = "Faktor",
  ylab = "Eigenvalue",
  main = "Parallel Analysis"
)

lines(
  1:p,
  mean_random_eigenvalues,
  type = "b",
  pch = 19,
  lty = 2
)

legend(
  "topright",
  legend = c("Valódi adatok", "Random adatok"),
  lty = c(1, 2),
  pch = 19
)
```
